# Nano Empire AI

## Architecture & Agent Operating Model (Anthropic Oct 2026 Guidance)

- Single Main Agent Loop with progressive disclosure of skills and tools. Nano Empire exposes atomic tools via MCP and x402 endpoints rather than requiring multi-agent overhead for linear tasks.
- Isolated adversarial DAGs are reserved for verification sandboxes (SkillProof Sprint test batteries).
- Complete M2M briefing and protocol synthesis: https://nanoempireai.com/m2m-state.md

## Live: machine endpoints (x402, Base, USDC)

- Health (free): GET https://recallguard-api.vercel.app/api/v1/health
- Feed, $0.05 per call: GET https://recallguard-api.vercel.app/api/v1/feed?limit=50
  Returns normalized CPSC and FDA recall records. Unpaid calls return HTTP 402.
- Match, $0.10 per call: POST https://recallguard-api.vercel.app/api/v1/match
  Input: {"items":[{"name":"string","brand":"string","upc":"string"}]}
  Output: {"matches":[{"recall_id":"string","severity":"string","hazard":"string","remedy":"string"}]}
  Unpaid calls return HTTP 402.

## Payment terms

- Protocol: x402 (HTTP 402 challenge, pay, retry)
- Network: base
- Asset (Base USDC): 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913
- Pay to: 0x90E23A7b6F6494A879d05DDC4278D0e55Dec1e01
- Facilitator: coinbase-x402-facilitator
- Receipt headers: X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE, X-402-Receipt
